The '''Kesla Vein pumping station''' was a [[Water/Legends|water]] pumping station in the small [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Kesla Vein]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]]. In [[44 ABY]], here there was the [[First duel in Kesla Vein|first confront]] between the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], his son, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]], and their friend, [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]] and a group of [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith]] led by [[Sith Saber]] [[Tola Annax]], both in searching the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] being [[Abeloth]], who had achieved control over the native [[Theran Listener]]s [[The Force/Legends|Force]] organization. However, the jedi escape the confrontation and continued the search of Abeloth.
